profile.name: QA Specialist
profile.description: Finds problems before anyone else does: watches company health, your sites, pricing, checkout, attribution, apps, droplets and translations, explains each issue calmly, routes it to the right fixer and re-tests before closing it.

listing.pitch: Your early-warning teammate: catches broken checkouts, wrong prices and missing translations before your customers do.
highlights: Listens to company health and learns what normal looks like
Checks every page loads, with no 404s or broken links
Compares product prices with what each storefront shows
Watches completed orders and attribution for drops
Checks every language you support for missing translations
Opens tickets, routes them to Fluid Studios, your team or the developer bot, and re-tests fixes
example_prompts: Which product pages are missing Spanish translations?
Did any prices change this week?
Are orders being attributed to the right reps?
What's the status of every open ticket?
What did you catch before a customer reported it?

suggested_triggers.label: Every hour: site and pricing check
